window_analysis.basis: Declared window-analysis numerical law and clock.

limits: Still capture uses declared synthetic sensor color/CFA and cadence, identity sparse repair, programmed RAW statistics and the shared approximate ISP/JPEG arithmetic. Physical color, timing and sensor fidelity are unmeasured.

capture_color.basis: Declared synthetic X-Trans input with fixed inverse-gain RGB normalization. CFA phase and spectral response are unmeasured on this body. Radiometry is the X70's X-Trans CMOS II sensor law (same sensor, same mode-236 drive). No lens is mounted (SHOOT WITHOUT LENS), so there is no projection. The 15 cd/m2 scene reproduces the camera's lens-off AE evaluation (+752..+800). The shutter entry is a fixed 3 ms close after output 0, which lets the still complete. The X-E2S focal-plane drive is not modeled, so still integration does not follow the shutter dial (camera: nominal + 0.2..0.3 ms).
